items.headline: Singapore starts removing ERP gantries as it switches to satellite road pricing
items.summary: Singapore has begun progressively taking down its ERP gantries as it moves to a satellite-based ERP 2.0 system from Jan 1, 2027, using an in-vehicle on-board unit.

items.headline: Woman charged after a Punggol block's rubbish chute caught fire 13 times in 12 days
items.summary: A 33-year-old woman was charged on Nov 20 with mischief by fire after a Punggol HDB rubbish chute caught fire 13 times in 12 days.

items.headline: Singaporean woman, 44, charged over alleged ties to the Prince Holding scam syndicate
items.summary: A 44-year-old Singaporean woman was arrested and charged over alleged links to the Cambodia-based Prince Holding Group cyber-scam conglomerate.

items.headline: Man jailed 12 weeks for looking up a woman's skirt at an MRT station
items.summary: A 31-year-old man was jailed 12 weeks for filming up a woman's skirt at Botanic Gardens MRT station; he had a similar 2024 conviction.

items.headline: India's retail inflation breaches the RBI's 6% ceiling as foreign money floods back in
items.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, breaching the RBI's 6% ceiling, even as foreign investors poured a record $10bn-plus into Indian equities in November.

items.headline: Zelensky presses for four-way peace talks as Europe pushes for a seat at the table
items.summary: Zelensky urged a four-way Ukraine-US-Russia-Europe meeting as European leaders (E5) press for a seat; a trilateral round was held in Abu Dhabi Nov 10-11, with no new date set and Moscow resisting European participation.

items.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza's al-Shati camp kills a family of four as the truce frays
items.summary: An Israeli strike on al-Shati camp killed Hamas security official Muhammad Abu al-Awf, his wife and two daughters on Nov 25; over 1,680 have died since the Oct 2025 ceasefire.

items.headline: RSF drone attacks kill at least 19 in Sudan's Blue Nile state
items.summary: Overnight RSF drone attacks killed at least 19 in Sudan's Blue Nile state, hitting Damazin and the Roseires dam, days after Khartoum strikes damaged a UN building.

items.headline: A year after the Tai Po fire that killed 168, Hong Kong's manslaughter case grinds on
items.summary: A year after the Wang Fuk Court fire killed 168, seven people and two firms face 25 charges including manslaughter; rights groups cite curbs on memorials.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix and approve code
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, with Code Review generally available and beta agents PR Steward and Claude Approvals rolling out to Team/Enterprise users on GitHub.

items.headline: Britain's Fractile raises $720 million to build AI inference chips
items.summary: UK chip startup Fractile raised a $720m Series C at around a $7bn valuation, backed by the UK sovereign AI fund, Thrive, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint.

items.headline: AI agent startup LangChain hits a $3 billion valuation
items.summary: LangChain reached a $3bn valuation on a roughly $300m Series C led by CapitalG, highlighting investor appetite for the AI-agent tooling layer.

items.headline: Wall Street's AI sell-off deepens as Nvidia is placed on S&P CreditWatch
items.summary: The Nasdaq fell up to 4.6% intraday before closing down ~0.6% on Nov 25; Nvidia dropped ~3.9% to $149.30 after S&P placed it on CreditWatch negative.

items.headline: Dell and HP beat earnings estimates on AI and PC demand
items.summary: Dell's revenue roughly doubled to about $54.9bn and HP's Q4 revenue of $16.0bn beat forecasts on AI-server and PC demand; Dell shares slid on margin concerns.

items.headline: OPEC+ heads into its most consequential supply decision of the year
items.summary: OPEC+ meets in late November to set 2027 output; the UAE has pushed back on its limits and Iraq resists a sub-5m bpd assessment, with oil near three-month lows.

items.headline: Markets brace for a near-certain December Fed rate hike after hot inflation data
items.summary: Markets put ~94% odds on a December Fed hike after hot PCE data, which would be a second straight increase; tariff proposals and the AI rout added pressure.

items.headline: F1's Qatar race becomes a two-stopper as Pirelli caps stints at 27 laps
items.summary: Pirelli capped tyre stints at 27 laps of 57 for the Qatar GP (Nov 27-29), forcing two stops; the title is already settled so strategy could shape the order.

items.headline: Verstappen eyes runner-up spot as F1's title fights arrive settled in Qatar
items.summary: With Antonelli and Mercedes champions, Verstappen (304 pts) reaches Qatar chasing second, 37 clear of Hamilton (267), with Russell and Norris on 264.

items.headline: New Zealand lose Blair Tickner to injury before the Christchurch Test
items.summary: New Zealand lost Blair Tickner (hamstring) before the second Test vs India at Christchurch from Nov 27; Matt Fisher was called up. The series is level after a Wellington draw.

items.headline: Czechia beat Canada to reach their first Davis Cup semi-final since 2014
items.summary: Czechia beat Canada 2-0 in Bologna (Machac d. Draxl, Lehecka d. Auger-Aliassime) to reach their first Davis Cup semi-final since 2014.

items.headline: Euclid and Webb spot the most distant quasar yet, 630 million years after the Big Bang
items.summary: ESA's Euclid, with Webb follow-up, found the most distant quasar yet, seen 630m years after the Big Bang and powered by a ~360m-solar-mass black hole.

items.headline: Hera's first close-ups reveal a stadium-sized crater on asteroid Dimorphos
items.summary: ESA's Hera returned first close-ups of Dimorphos showing a crater nearly as wide as the ~150m body, from NASA's 2022 DART impact; the asteroid is tumbling chaotically.

items.headline: A genome study of 1.2 million people maps 343 DNA regions behind chronic pain
items.summary: A genome-wide study of 1.2m people mapped 343 DNA regions linked to chronic pain (92 new), pointing toward non-opioid treatment targets, in Nature Neuroscience.

fun_fact.headline: If you shuffle a deck of 52 cards, that exact order has probably never existed before
fun_fact.body: If you give a standard 52-card deck a thorough shuffle, the exact order you end up with has almost certainly never existed before in the history of the world. There are 52! possible arrangements (about 8 x 10^67), which dwarfs the number of seconds since the Big Bang, so each properly shuffled deck is, in all likelihood, a genuine world first.

puzzle.title: The Rolling Die
puzzle.body: A standard die (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 1 on top, 2 facing south, 3 facing east. It is rolled one step east (tipped over its east edge), then one step north. Which number is now on top?
puzzle.approach: Track the die face by face through each roll; opposite faces always sum to 7.
puzzle.answer: 2. After rolling east: top 4, east 1, bottom 3, west 6 (N 5, S 2). After rolling north: top 2, north 4, bottom 5, south 3 (E 1, W 6). Top is 2, with 5 underneath (2+5=7).

word_puzzle.title: Set in Stone
word_puzzle.body: Sort 16 words into 4 groups of 4: LIME, OLIVE, HEART, RUBY, BRIM, JADE, SPADE, PEARL, CORNER, FOREST, CLUB, OPAL, MILE, EMERALD, DIAMOND, CORAL.
word_puzzle.approach: Three groups hide a gem-shaped trap; find the word that only looks precious.
word_puzzle.answer: ___+STONE: LIME, BRIM, CORNER, MILE. Shades of green: OLIVE, JADE, FOREST, EMERALD. Card suits: HEART, SPADE, CLUB, DIAMOND. Gemstones: RUBY, PEARL, OPAL, CORAL.
